clauses.text: The T2 built-in microphone records your own speech clearly once the experimental switch is on

steps.do: Read the risk card first (Settings, Sound, Microphone, Enter). Only switch it on if you can power the Mac off if it freezes. Then speak a sentence close to the Mac and play it back in the VOICE tile, RECORD tab.
steps.expect: Your speech is recorded and plays back clearly at a normal level, with no freeze.
